note: kick and slow give omega_j/log l_j <= min(kappa/4, j^-2) and fits gives the second bound, but [L]'s constant is the explicit sum 1+paths+width^-1+columns+relaxation+supportExponent where [M]'s calligraphic C_j also includes the source comparison constants, and the bounds are required only for j >= p.first.

structure Large (p : Sheet G) (j : ℕ) (L : Side) : Prop where
  odd : Odd L.val
  size : 3 ≤ L.val
  need : p.floorL j ≤ L.val
  kick (hj : p.first ≤ j) : (p.profile j).drift / Real.log L.val ≤ G.slopeConstant/4
  slow (hj : p.first ≤ j) : (p.profile j).drift / Real.log L.val ≤ ((j:ℝ)^2)⁻¹
  fits (hj : p.first ≤ j) :
    let X := p.profile j
    Real.log (1 + X.paths + X.width⁻¹ + X.columns + X.clip.relaxation + X.supportExponent) /
      Real.log L.val ≤ ((j:ℝ)^2)⁻¹
